entries.title: A task that was starting when you quit starts again next time
entries.body: Quitting Infinitary while a task was starting, whether it started from the queue or once another computer finished signing in, no longer counts as a failed start. Your first mate no longer tells you it could not start, and the task starts again the next time Infinitary opens.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; what changes is that a quit during a start is no longer reported as a failure.
